children.value: > Fact From Story: Ten Hag will take the blame of course for the early exit and plenty of mistakes have been made, not least in the players the manager has been allowed to sign.
> > Fact From Story: assessing the job any United manager does with this team involves applying a series of filters.

> > > Fact From Story: Win things, improve players, create a coherent and happy internal culture: but do it during an unceasing takeover circus while star players sulk and brief against you, while the ghost of Hamlet’s father still skulks in the eaves.
> > > Fact From Story: To be United manager is to undertake three concurrent roles.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Managing a team involves numerous complex factors and challenges.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Managers are responsible for the performance of the team and the players they choose.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Managers are often blamed when their team does not perform well.
